principles: Never equate more columns with more information. Compare information patterns on chronological pre-holdout OOS.
Feature availability, identity and PIT are upstream gates. Pattern selection cannot rescue invalid provenance.
Selection must be event-cluster/time-aware; the same event at multiple cutoffs is not independent evidence.
Do not silently discard a sport because a preferred family is missing. Missing families are explicit and the candidate falls back to validated broader patterns.
Profile, roster, performance, form, competition, matchday, source-quality and interaction signals are separate families.
Sport-specific priority is allowed, but the optimizer must test alternative families and combinations rather than hard-code one universal feature recipe.
Pattern complexity is penalized when predictive quality is comparable. Simpler patterns win ties.
Pattern results are research evidence until downstream chronological OOS, robustness and frozen-holdout release gates pass.

families.identity_strength: Elo, opponent strength, H2H, historical participation
families.form_load: recent results, streaks, margins, rest, schedule load
families.performance_history: prior match/player/team statistics and multiscale summaries
families.entity_profile: age, height, reach, stance, position, role, player/athlete profile
families.team_roster_context: roster, starters, lineup, role/position, team composition
families.competition_context: competition, season, stage, round, event type, rules
families.matchday_intelligence: availability, injuries, weather, market/news, late official updates
families.interaction: differences, ratios, relative values, cross-family interactions

search_budget.complexity_penalty: dispersion + feature_count tie-break + source_dependence penalty when predictive quality is comparable
search_budget.acceptance_hint: pattern screen is never production authorization
search_budget.selection_holdout_policy: pattern selection uses only an early non-holdout prefix; later OOS and frozen holdout are untouched

stages.name: downstream_model_ecology
stages.rule: selected pattern is passed to the full sport model ecology and later chronological OOS; no pattern-selection row may be reused as OOS evidence

stages.name: selection_stability_and_negative_control_check
stages.description: compare selected recipes against ranking-family disagreement, leave-one-family-out controls and per-period stability before downstream OOS

search_space.dependency_handling: all comparisons use identical chronological folds; same-event snapshots are clustered elsewhere and never treated as independent samples
search_space.holdout_firewall: pattern selection never reads frozen-holdout labels and never tunes against frozen-holdout performance
search_space.search_policy: maximize structured diversity first, then select on robust chronological performance; never brute-force arbitrary powersets
